caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #81: NASCENT

nascent (adjective): just coming into existence and beginning to develop.

✅ In a sentence: The nascent electric-car industry faced many skeptics in its early years.
✅ Similar: emerging, budding, developing
✅ Remember it: Same root as "natal" (birth).
